newsitem.title: USA: Gloucester Cty, N.J., mulls tax increase - paper.
newsitem.headline: Gloucester Cty, N.J., mulls tax increase - paper.

text.p: The Gloucester County, N.J., Board of Freeholders may have to raise county taxes after a nearly a decade of reductions in the tax rate because of less state money and increased budget demands, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Monday.

A $94 million budget was proposed, but even after tentatively agreeing to delay 30 hires, freeholders may still have to raise taxes 3.5 cents per $100 of assessed valuation, the paper reported. That would raise taxes to 59.5 cents, a $35 increase to $595 for a home assessed at $100,000.
Freeholders could decide not to raise taxes and cut spending insteads, the paper reported, but the budget is tight.
